messages:
neha: Datadog PM ping 1: they want a combined launch package for the marketplace tile + joint blog. Ask: ops checklist, sanitized dashboard JSON, legal blurb for press, and an embargo window. Can we assemble this by EOW?

tomas: Eng: yes. We'll need: 1) minimal OTLP -> Datadog exporter snippet, 2) metric names list, 3) a short smoke-test runbook. Also confirm ingest caps for marketplace customers.

linda: Marketing: we'll need a 2-paragraph co-authored blog draft + three screenshotable dashboard images (US/EU/GovCloud). Embargo: prefer 2 business days for partner review.

gavin: Legal: we can provide a public-facing checklist and a DPA summary link. No contractual promises in the public doc. Must include "no customer-identifiable data in screenshots" checkbox and a pointer to regional data handling.

mike: Security/ops: require per-tenant API keys in KMS, support for site selection (datadoghq.com / datadoghq.eu / dd-gov.datadoghq), and mTLS to intake. Suggest HMAC keyed hashing for user identifiers to reduce re-id risk.

neha: OK. Tomas can you paste the tiny OTLP snippet we'll show in docs? Keep it minimal and anonymized.

tomas: posted snippet (YAML):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  sanitize:
    rules:
      - key: user.email
        action: remove
      - key: request.body
        action: remove
  batch: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}   # per-tenant, store in KMS
    site: datadoghq.com      # datadoghq.eu or dd-gov.datadoghq as needed
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [sanitize, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

linda: can you also include a one-line sampling suggestion for the doc? marketing wants to call out "cost-control" best practices.

tomas: add this line to the blurb: "Recommend tail-sampling: retain 10% of traces generally and apply 100% sampling for spans >2s to capture errors."

gavin: Legal checklist items to include in the public package: ["Confirm data residency per-customer","No PII in screenshots","Link to DPA summary","Statement: we publish operational guidance only, not contractual guarantees"].

mike: QA bot: smoke-test scheduled when staging exporter is up. Tagging: @qa-bot to run ingestion + dashboard render check.

qa-bot: smoke-test queued for partner=redwood, env=staging. Will validate 3 metrics: redwood.request.latency_p95, redwood.token.count, redwood.model.fallback_rate.

neha: owners & ETA: 1) Tomas - sanitized exporter snippet + sampling sentence (due Wed EOD). 2) Linda - blog draft + 3 screenshots (due Thu). 3) Gavin - public checklist + DPA link (due Thu). 4) Mike - ops security notes (KMS/HMAC/mTLS) + runbook (due Fri). 5) QA-bot - run smoke test after staging push.

tomas: created branch partners/datadog-launch and pushed exporter changes + tiny test fixture.

qa-bot: smoke-test: ingestion success (2026-03-22T09:14:02Z) 120 traces accepted, 0 rejects. Dashboard render OK (3 snapshots available).

neha: perfect. Linda please prepare the embargo email copy (2 business days) and ping datadog-partners@ once legal signs off. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
